blocks.assessment: ADR05001 records reference-based input and owned candidates without Clone. blocks.assessment: ADR05002 defines a bounded single active path, stable model IDs, leaf-to-parent Unhandled fallback, terminal refusal and exact external/internal hook order. Parent selection does not change the exit domain; orthogonal regions and implicit completion loops are unsupported. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

Durable publication requires independently authenticated exact receipts. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.preview: 4. **ADR-050-04 — Protocol:** Machine v1 canonical encoding, stable IDs, schema/definition pinning, event dige
blocks.assessment: ADR05004 plus machine-wire.md specify independent protocol tag/layout, model/schema identities, event/state/intent digest binding and complete batch receipts. Golden fixtures are independent of Rust encoding. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.preview: 5. **ADR-050-05 — Durability:** Head vs event log authority, local transaction scope, immutable payload retent
blocks.assessment: ADR05005 and storage guide specify accepted history authority, coherent head snapshots, local atomicity, immutable event/state/intent retention, isolated event replay and snapshot restore. External effect authority remains native. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.section: 16. Key decisions to record as ADRs
blocks.preview: 6. **ADR-050-06 — Refactor limits:** Shared code extraction map vs preserved saga/task/timeline semantic types
blocks.assessment: ADR05006 lists concrete shared helpers/owners and intentionally separate saga correlation, task generations, timeline finality and domain transactions. Inventory documents source growth and limited clone scope; it does not claim universal deduplication. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.assessment: ADR05007 records host context and machine-specific authorization operations, denial before scoped existence/duplicate reads and preserved legacy enum semantics. It does not authenticate pure reducers or arbitrary caller assertions. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.assessment: ADR05008 retains facade defaults, optional timeline/SQLite/runtime composition and allocation-free/no_std qualification at core. There is no mandatory macro. Feature/dependency and portable checks remain independent gates. Historical sequencing remains unproven.

blocks.preview: 9. **ADR-050-09 — Migration:** What constitutes schema-compatible restart, when an explicit transformation is
blocks.assessment: ADR05009 requires pinned interpretation, explicit authenticated migration when changing it and separately restored old backups for rollback. No automatic downgrade or unsupported schema reinterpretation is offered. Historical sequencing remains unproven.
